prompt: Perform one sequential image-observation task using only read_image. First call read_image for image-A.png. After receiving its actual image result, describe distinctive visible details, then call read_image for image-B.png. After receiving B's actual result, describe its visible elements, compare A and B, and finish. Use exactly two read_image calls, one per model response, in A, B order. Do not batch or parallelize calls. Do not read any other files or use other tools. Base descriptions on the observed images; do not infer contents from filenames. No rendering or editing is requested.
